sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Control on Possession and Consumption of Drugs Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE, LVI OF 2001
ORDINANCE, LVI OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
CONTROL ON POSSESSION AND CONSUMPTION
OF DRUGS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Control on Possession
and Consumption of Drugs Act, 1973
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
1st January, 2002]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 1‑1‑2002.‑‑-The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 21st December, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Balochistan Control on Possession and Consumption of Drugs (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shad come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.

An Ordinance further

and Consumption of Drugs Act, 1973
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
1st January, 2002]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 1‑1‑2002.‑‑-The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 21st December, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:
2. Amendment of section 12 of Act V of 1973.‑‑‑In
the Balochistan Control on Possession and Consumption of Drugs Act, 1973, in
section 12, for the words "Director Health Services, District Health
Officers" the words "Executive District Officer Health" shall be
substituted.
